name: new_v2_five_observed_axis_robustness_envelope_v1
posture_axis: ROAM-EMG unseen-user pooled static label-bout macro-F1 over resting, hanging, unsupported and reaching. Per-posture and subject-by-posture minima are separately reported.
aggregation: unweighted descriptive mean and minimum of five axis-specific pooled macro-F1 values; retain worst subject/condition cell and worst ROAM posture separately
selection: Report all four arms in validation/final; no post-hoc final-based arm selection
boundary: Force, wearing, day, user and posture arise from different public datasets, rates, labels and splits; day and user share GRABMyo records. ROAM posture target subjects are unseen and differ from resting source subjects, so source-to-target user and posture shifts coexist. Five-axis mean is descriptive, not pooled accuracy; own 250 Hz device, speed and real signal quality remain unobserved for this exact bank.
